name: Mongolia
description: Mongolia from the Xiongnu to Genghis Khan and the Mongol Empire, the Qing, the revolution of 1921, communism and democracy.

checkpoints.name: Steppe empires
checkpoints.note: The Xiongnu, Turks and Uyghurs ruled the steppe.

checkpoints.name: The Mongol Empire
checkpoints.note: Genghis Khan united the tribes in 1206 and conquered from China to Europe.

checkpoints.name: Qing rule
checkpoints.note: The Qing ruled Mongolia for nearly three centuries.

checkpoints.name: Modern Mongolia
checkpoints.note: Mongolia broke from China in 1911, became communist in 1924 and democratic in 1990.
